paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption: : Ratio of clipped signals.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the ratio of clipped signals over training steps for two different policy configurations: “On-policy” and “Mixed-policy w/ Shaping.” The x-axis, labeled “Steps,” spans from 0 to approximately 500 with linear scaling and tick marks at intervals of 100. The y-axis, labeled “Clip Ratio (%)”, ranges from 0.00 to 0.20, also with linear scaling and tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The “On-policy” curve, depicted in dark blue with a solid line, begins near 0.06 at step 0, dips slightly, then fluctuates between 0.04 and 0.07 for the remainder of the steps, showing minor oscillations without a clear trend. The “Mixed-policy w/ Shaping” curve, shown in red with a solid line, starts near 0.20 at step 0, drops sharply to around 0.14 by step 50, and then continues to oscillate between approximately 0.09 and 0.15 for the rest of the training, with persistent high-frequency noise. Both lines exhibit stochastic behavior typical of reinforcement learning training curves, with the red line consistently maintaining a higher clip ratio than the blue line across all steps.
